quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken press release: Establishment of a Joint Venture Company (07-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Subsidiary Seikoh Giken Hangzhou is forming a joint venture, Zhengzhou SINY Optic-COM (scheduled establishment August 1, 2026; Seikoh Giken Hangzhou 25%, SINY Optic-COM 75%), with Chinese optical isolator maker SINY Optic-COM, to build a mass-production system for high-performance optical isolators to meet rapidly growing demand for 800G/1.6T optical transceivers and optical modules for AI data centers, and to sell them through the group's network in Japan, North America and Europe. The company expects minimal impact on consolidated results for the fiscal year ending March 2027.
